_comment: turn-pipeline.md status:"done" contract — a model can (wrongly) pair status:"done" with a real tool call in the same step (report_status(done) alongside e.g. create_intention). activities/activities/model_call.py must coerce that contradictory status to "working" (the one place both signals are known together) rather than let turn.go's `done` branch break on it and silently drop the tool call. Regression for a real bug found via a live reminder request whose create_intention call was minted into tool_calls (status=pending) and then discarded because nothing reconciled the two signals.
